description: ARCEP 2020 is a dataset listed in cc-lacqorthez-data64 open data portal, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a region, department, metropolitan area or agency, published or maintained by ARCEP - ithéa conseil. Données ARCEP mises à disposition par Ithéa conseil. Coverage: Lacq-Orthez (Pyrénées-Atlantiques). The portal files it under Territoires, Équipements. Its keywords are ARCEP, ithéa conseil. The portal shows 65 records. It carries geographic features and can be exported as GeoJSON, KML or Shapefile. The portal shows 2022-02-22 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Licence Ouverte v2.0 (Etalab). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support telecommunication coverage and network deployment studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-opendata-cc-lacqorthez-fr-portal.
